entries.zh: 鬱熱：熱邪鬱積於內、身體燥熱難當的病症；患者因內熱而煩躁如焚
entries.en: sick with pent-up heat; a patient burning with internal heat

entries.zh: 舊病復發、病勢纏綿不癒的人（「病拖」謂久病拖磨）
entries.en: a sick person suffering a relapse; one whose illness drags on and returns
entries.notes: H 欄「拖缺」末字費解，疑為方言記音；義依 L「recaída」（復發）與「病拖」定。

entries.zh: 沉痾：病邪深陷、病情危重難治的疾病
entries.en: a very dangerous illness; deep-seated, grave sickness
entries.notes: H 欄末字原作「阿」，疑為「痾」，「沉痾」即久病重病。

entries.zh: 痛苦沉重、有性命之危的重病
entries.en: a grave and dangerous illness; a severe, distressing sickness
entries.notes: H 欄首字「辛/幸」存疑，M、R 末音節僅對應「重」，義依 L「graue, peligrosa」定為危重。

entries.zh: 危險的病症（「呆症」疑指神識昏憒、癡呆失神的重病）
entries.en: a dangerous illness; a grave sickness attended by dulled senses
entries.notes: H 欄首字「呆/杏」存疑，M 三音節與 R 二音節不齊，僅能依 L 定為危險之症。

entries.zh: 危急：病情凶險、瀕於危殆
entries.en: a critical illness; a perilous, life-threatening condition

entries.zh: 危險：性命垂危的病況
entries.en: dangerous; perilous (of an illness)

entries.zh: 病勢沉重、已至末期瀕危的患者
entries.en: a sick person at death's door; gravely ill and near the end

entries.zh: 隱疾：潛藏未顯、不易察覺的病症
entries.en: a hidden illness; a latent, concealed disease

entries.zh: 瘴氣：濕熱蒸鬱所生的疫癘之氣，染之則病且易相傳
entries.en: miasma; pestilential vapour held to cause contagious disease

entries.zh: 惹病：沾染、招致疾病；傳染得病
entries.en: to contract a disease; to catch an infectious illness

entries.zh: 身體不適、不快活；病情不見好轉（西文原欄殘損難讀）
entries.en: unwell, out of sorts; an illness that does not improve
entries.notes: L 欄殘損（「nomojoira, mi disgusa」不成句），僅據 H「不快活」與 M、R 對音推定。

entries.zh: 素來體弱多病的人；破病之身
entries.en: sickly by nature; a chronically ailing person

entries.zh: 積勞成疾：因過度勞累而致病的患者
entries.en: sick from overwork; worn down by excessive toil
entries.notes: L 欄殘損且拼寫訛亂，義依 H「過勞」與 M、R 對音定。

entries.zh: 染病：被傳染而患病的人
entries.en: one who has caught the disease; an infected patient

entries.zh: 性情乖張、挑剔易怒、難以伺候的病人
entries.en: a peevish, hard-to-please sick person; a querulous invalid
entries.notes: H 欄「鮮嘗」與 M、R 對音不洽，無從互證，義僅依 L「malcontentadizo」推定。

entries.zh: 重滯：病勢沉重、氣血滯塞不通的危重患者
entries.en: a dangerously ill patient; a grave illness marked by heaviness and stagnation
entries.notes: 「重滯」為中医氣血滯重之語，與 L「peligroso」僅大致相合，義有轉借。

entries.zh: 危篤：病危瀕死
entries.en: critically ill; at the point of death

entries.zh: 相思成疾：為情所困、因愛戀而致病的人
entries.en: lovesick; sick with love
entries.notes: H 欄首字原作「系」，疑為「繫」；義依 L「enfermo de amores」定為相思之病。

entries.zh: 乏力倦怠、四體不勤的患者（「無骨力」謂虛軟無勁）
entries.en: weak and listless; a sick person without strength
entries.notes: H 欄首字「不/毋」存疑；閩南語「骨力」謂勤力有勁，「無骨力」即乏力。

entries.zh: 風寒：外感風寒之症，傷風受涼而成
entries.en: a chill; illness from wind and cold

entries.zh: 感風个病：感受風邪所得的病，即傷風感冒
entries.en: the sickness of having caught a chill; a common cold
